_comment: I0 law-enforcement playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). Europol / EC3 takes no crime reports from citizens and does not contact them: never draft to it. A victim or PI goes to the national police; the national case officer decides whether to involve Europol (or Eurojust) for cross-border linking. Every path is LE-only, so the next action is a brief to the national case officer.
notes: Europol has no power to arrest or to investigate on information from citizens and deals only with information from the competent law-enforcement agencies; it issues no freezing order itself (freezing / evidence orders between member states are national: Reg. (EU) 2018/1805, EIO). Its 'Report cybercrime online' page lists the national reporting sites.

instrument.notes: Through the member state's Europol national unit (SIENA); nothing from the victim side.

paths.notes: Ask the national case officer (e.g. Carabinieri, Polizia Postale) whether to pass the case to Europol for multi-country linking. No reply to a citizen is expected.
